hero.title: Built for Amazon Sellers
hero.subtitle: SyncroSale connects to your Amazon store through the Selling Partner API (SP-API) to manage listings, inventory, orders, pricing, shipping and profit analysis in one place.

listing.title: Listing, Inventory & Order Management
listing.intro: SyncroSale turns your Amazon store into a managed pipeline. You decide which products are allowed in. SyncroSale discovers them, checks them against your rules, lists them and keeps them in order, then follows every order from purchase to delivery.

i1.title: Inventory by stage
i1.description: See every product by where it is in the pipeline: discovery, filtering, pending approval, importing to Amazon, active, inactive, incomplete and deleted. Nothing disappears without a status.

i2.title: Filters and saved views
i2.description: Filter by Buy Box and competition data, sales rank, seller counts, price and margin gaps, stock, dates, profit and more. Save any filter set as its own tab.

i3.title: Clear out-of-criteria reasons
i3.description: Every rejected product tells you why: restricted brand, keyword, category or ASIN, no sales rank, unavailable in the source marketplace, an FBA or Amazon seller present, or too few or too many sellers.

i4.title: Restrictions and blocked ASINs
i4.description: Maintain lists of restricted brands, keywords, categories and ASINs. A global blocked ASIN list is kept per marketplace.

i5.title: Policy-warning protection
i5.description: Choose what happens when Amazon sends a policy warning, a product safety notice or a case closure notice: do nothing, remove from inventory, remove and block the product, or remove and block the product and its brand.

i6.title: Creation and removal rules
i6.description: Decide whether new products are never added without approval, need your approval, or are added automatically when they meet your filters. Decide whether products that stop meeting your criteria are kept or removed.

i7.title: Bulk actions and import tracking
i7.description: Add or delete up to 5,000 products by ASIN or SKU in one action. The import tracker shows each batch, the result per ASIN and the drop reason.

i8.title: Price history
i8.description: Review every price change in a table, ledger or audit log, with the cost breakdown, commission, tax, exchange rate, handling time, margins and the Buy Box and lowest offers behind it.

i9.title: Multiple marketplaces
i9.description: Connect each Amazon marketplace separately through SP-API authorization. Every store keeps its own filters and settings, and an expired authorization can be renewed in one step.

i10.title: Order list that fits real work
i10.description: Tabs for all orders, pending actions, orders to be purchased and delayed orders. Create colored flags, and search by buyer, date, ASIN, tracking number, status, notes or days since purchase.

i11.title: Everything about an order in one place
i11.description: Delivery address, items, supply orders, notes, warehouse packages and an event timeline you can filter by who caused the event: you, Amazon, a seller e-mail, the warehouse or the system.

i12.title: Notifications and e-mail matched to orders
i12.description: Order, shipping, cancellation, return and refund messages from Amazon and your buyer mailbox are read and matched to the right order. Anything unmatched waits in an unprocessed inbox so nothing is lost.

i13.title: Customer invoices
i13.description: Edit and preview an invoice, choose a template and language, adjust items, VAT rate and notes, then print or save it as PDF. Your seller address and logo are set once in store settings.

s1.title: Add products
s1.description: Add ASINs to your store, up to 5,000 at a time, with an optional SKU prefix.

s2.title: Discovery
s2.description: SyncroSale collects Amazon data for each ASIN. Products that cannot be found are reported together with the reason.

s3.title: Filtering
s3.description: Your filters and restrictions are applied. Products that fail go to Out of Criteria with the exact reason, the rest move on.

s4.title: Listing
s4.description: Depending on your setting, products are added automatically, or wait in Pending Approval until you approve selected or all of them.

pricing.title: Automated Pricing
pricing.intro: Pricing in SyncroSale is a set of rules that you control. For every product it works out a price band, moves the price inside that band according to the competition, and sends the result to Amazon together with stock and handling time.

i1.title: Profit rules by cost range
i1.description: Create as many cost ranges as you need. Each one has its own minimum, standard and maximum profit percentage, and a default row covers everything else.

i2.title: Buy Box or lowest price
i2.description: Choose which offer your price is compared with. You can match it, or undercut it by a value you set. An unusually large undercut triggers a warning before you save.

i3.title: Buy Box eligibility check
i3.description: Compete only with sellers who are actually eligible to win the Buy Box, instead of every offer on the listing.

i4.title: Ignore list
i4.description: Add seller IDs you do not want to compete with. They stop influencing your prices.

i5.title: Sole-seller margin
i5.description: When nobody else sells a product, SyncroSale prices at your maximum plus an extra percentage that you choose.

i6.title: No-Buy-Box fallback
i6.description: Pick the minimum, standard or maximum price to use when a listing currently has no Buy Box seller.

i7.title: You choose how prices are applied
i7.description: Keep prices continuously updated by smart pricing, or stop price updates after the initial import.

i8.title: Currency, tax and commission
i8.description: Use an automatic or a manual exchange rate, set your Amazon commission rate, and add a tax rule as an extra percentage plus a fixed amount where it applies.

i9.title: Stock and handling time
i9.description: Set a maximum stock and a critical stock level that resets stock to zero to protect you from overselling. For slow suppliers, handling time can be extended as far as Amazon allows, up to 30 days.

i10.title: Protected API quota
i10.description: Choose a minimum wait before price, stock and handling changes are sent to Amazon. Changes inside that window are combined into one update, while deletions and status changes are always sent immediately.

i11.title: Per-store control
i11.description: Every rule above is set per marketplace, so each store can follow its own strategy.

s1.title: True cost
s1.description: Product cost, supplier delivery cost, warehouse cost, Amazon commission, tax and exchange rate are combined into the real cost of each product.

s2.title: Margin band
s2.description: The product's cost range selects a rule with a minimum, standard and maximum profit percentage. If no range matches, your default rule applies.

s3.title: Competition
s3.description: Your standard price is compared with the Buy Box or lowest offer and matched or undercut, but it never leaves your minimum and maximum.

s4.title: Update Amazon
s4.description: Price, stock and handling time are sent to Amazon, batched at the interval you choose.

shipping.title: Shipping Solutions
shipping.intro: SyncroSale connects your orders to partner warehouses and reports the shipment back to Amazon. Packages, labels, messages and tracking stay attached to the order they belong to.

i1.title: Partner warehouses
i1.description: Orders are fulfilled through integrated partner warehouses, including SESA Shipping and regional partners.

i2.title: Default carrier service
i2.description: Choose the carrier and service that new shipments use by default. Existing shipments keep the service they were created with.

i3.title: Package lifecycle
i3.description: Follow each package through pending registration, registered, received, shipped, in transit, delivered, exception, returned or cancelled.

i4.title: Shipping and return labels
i4.description: Open or recreate a shipping label from the order, and attach a return label as PDF, JPG or PNG up to 5 MB.

i5.title: When Amazon is told
i5.description: Choose when shipments are confirmed on Amazon: when the buyer's order is shipped, or pre-confirmed with empty shipment details at the end of the handling time.

i6.title: Carrier and tracking update
i6.description: For pre-confirmed orders, choose whether the carrier and tracking number are filled in on Amazon once the order really ships, or left as they are.

i7.title: Warehouse messaging
i7.description: Send messages to the warehouse per package, with quick messages for common requests. Every warehouse event is recorded on the order timeline, and repeated or out-of-order updates are ignored.

s1.title: Package registered
s1.description: A package is registered with the warehouse for the order. If registration fails you can retry it or cancel the package.

s2.title: Warehouse receives
s2.description: When the warehouse reports that the package arrived, the order moves forward automatically.

s3.title: Warehouse ships
s3.description: When the package leaves the warehouse, the order is marked as shipped and the label is available on the order.

s4.title: Amazon is confirmed
s4.description: SyncroSale confirms the shipment on Amazon through SP-API with the carrier and tracking number.

analytics.title: Analytics & Reporting
analytics.intro: SyncroSale compares what an order was expected to earn with what it actually earned. Every figure is labeled as estimated, actual or overridden, so you always know how much of the number is real.

i1.title: Order profit breakdown
i1.description: Sale price, product cost, warehouse cost, Amazon commission, shipping cost, tax, promotion discount, customer refund, supplier refund and total profit, line by line.

i2.title: Estimated, actual, overridden
i2.description: Each line is tagged so you can tell a prediction from a real figure, and adjust a value manually when needed.

i3.title: Financial activity
i3.description: Expected, realized, final and variance tiles, with the source of each entry: system, mail, report or manual. A refund ledger lists each refund as estimated or realized.

i4.title: Orders report
i4.description: Filter orders by date and switch between a compact and a detailed view with the financial columns for every order.

i5.title: Dashboard KPIs
i5.description: Total profit, revenue, orders, average order value, successful and cancelled orders and cancellation requests, compared with the previous period.

i6.title: Dashboard charts
i6.description: Orders, revenue and profit over time, orders by hour of day, and the distribution of orders by status and flag. Choose today, 7 or 30 days, a year, or a custom range.

s1.title: Estimate
s1.description: When an order arrives, profit is estimated from the sale price, your product, warehouse and shipping costs, Amazon commission and tax.

s2.title: Actuals arrive
s2.description: Amazon financial data, refund e-mails and warehouse costs replace estimates as they come in. Commission data can take 3 to 7 days to arrive.

s3.title: Final result
s3.description: The order shows its final profit, and the difference between expected and realized values.

data.title: Your data, with your permission
data.description: SyncroSale accesses your Amazon account only after your explicit authorization through the Selling Partner API. You can revoke access at any time from Seller Central. Seller data is handled in accordance with Amazon's Acceptable Use Policy and Data Protection Policy.
